SCANNED: 2026-08-30

=== AGENT 365 SDK ===
Does NOT create or host agents. It ENHANCES agents already built on any stack by adding:
  - Entra-backed Agent Identity, including the agent's own user resources such as a MAILBOX
  - Notifications from Teams, Outlook, Word comments and emails - the agent participates like a human
  - Full observability via OpenTelemetry: agent interactions, INFERENCE EVENTS, and TOOL USAGE
  - Invocation of governed MCP servers reaching M365 workloads (Mail, Calendar, SharePoint, Teams) under admin control
  - Enforcement inside an IT-approved blueprint system so each instance inherits compliance/governance/security policy
Works with agents built on Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Agent Framework, Microsoft Agents SDK,
OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Code SDK, LangChain SDK - and with agent code hosted on Azure, AWS, GCP "or any other
cloud provider."
Layering: Enterprise Capabilities (Agent 365 SDK) / Agent Logic (your code) / LLM Orchestrator Runtime (your framework).
Distinct from the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK (hosting, activity protocol, identity) - it layers on top.

=== CROSS-CLOUD AUTO-REGISTRATION ===
"Enable Google Vertex AI or Amazon Bedrock agents - Registration for these agents requires NO development work -
agents are pulled automatically via the Google and Amazon APIs. No SDK integration, no blueprint, and no code
changes are required. Once registered, you can use the Agent 365 SDK to add observability, Work IQ tool access,
and other capabilities incrementally."
-> Agent 365 becomes a cross-cloud agent registry that ingests AWS Bedrock and GCP Vertex AI agents automatically.

=== AGENT 365 CLI ===
Creates agent blueprints and supporting resources; manages out-of-box and custom Work IQ tools, permissions and
tooling; deploys agent code to Azure; publishes agent application packages to the Microsoft admin center; cleans up
blueprints, identities and Azure resources.
Agent 365 Skills: an AI coding assistant (GitHub Copilot CLI, Claude Code, or VS Code agent mode) walks a developer
through installation, configuration, deployment and publishing.

=== ENTRA AGENT IDENTITY BLUEPRINT (Graph resource: agentIdentityBlueprint) ===
An OBJECT IN ENTRA ID that is a template for creating agent identities, and a special identity type in its own right.
A blueprint can perform exactly one tenant operation: provision or deprovision agent identities. It has an OAuth
client ID, credentials, and the special Graph permission `AgentIdentity.CreateAsManager`.
Shared properties: description, app roles, verified publisher, auth protocol settings (OptionalClaims).
CREDENTIALS ARE CONFIGURED ON THE BLUEPRINT: "OAuth permissions granted to an agent identity blueprint are granted
to ALL agent identities created from that blueprint."
INHERITABLE PERMISSIONS: define which resource apps have permissions automatically inherited by agent identities
created from the blueprint. "When an administrator grants permissions on the blueprint principal from an inheritable
resource app, ALL agent identities in that organization receive those permissions automatically."
REQUIRED RESOURCE ACCESS: declares APIs/permissions the agent needs; visible to admins at consent review.
Conditional Access can target a blueprint and take effect for all its agent identities. Disabling a blueprint
prevents all its agent identities from authenticating.
AGENT IDENTITY BLUEPRINT PRINCIPAL: the per-tenant object representing a blueprint's presence. Token `oid` claim
references it; blueprint actions (e.g. creating agent identities) are audited as the blueprint principal.
Blueprints can be SINGLE-TENANT or MULTITENANT and published to customers via Microsoft catalogs - a customer adds
a third-party blueprint to their tenant and it can then mint agent identities there.
Full schema: /graph/api/resources/agentidentityblueprint
